hero.headline: IT System Administrator {&} Network Engineer based in {Dhaka, Bangladesh}.
hero.intro: 4+ years architecting and maintaining high-availability, secure infrastructure for 300+ user environments. Full-stack management — from network security and virtualization to automation, monitoring, and AI-powered enterprise reporting. Actively advancing in Cloud and DevOps.

works.title: Physical-to-Virtual Migration & Network Redesign
works.summary: Migrated physical servers to high-availability Proxmox VE + Docker; redesigned the network as segmented VLANs on Cisco & MikroTik with VRRP and stateful firewalls; own the corporate email platform (Zextras Carbonio/Zimbra) end to end with Zabbix monitoring in front of it all.
works.value: 99% uptime for critical services, 30% better resource utilization, 24/7 secure communication for every user.

works.title: Conversational AI over a Live ERP
works.summary: Led the build and hardening of an AI reporting platform — chat interface plus KPI dashboards over two company databases — auditing every SQL tool the model can call and fixing critical data bugs, including an 8.9× KPI inflation error caught before it reached leadership.
works.value: Verified answers in seconds instead of days, over an $84M+ LC portfolio.

works.title: Group KPI Platform with Fully Local AI
works.summary: Three-tier architecture — production ERP, isolated report server, dedicated GPU inference node — so the AI assistant runs entirely on-premise, with role-based views for executives, finance, operations, and audit.
works.value: Board-level data gets AI-grade analysis while never leaving the company network.

works.title: Customs Declaration Automation (ASYCUDA)
works.summary: Desktop tool with an embedded database of 500+ company profiles, OCR with image preprocessing, and direct generation of submission-ready customs XML from scanned Bill of Entry documents.
works.value: Hours of error-prone typing → seconds of automated extraction; 100% field accuracy on digital documents.

works.title: Retail Storefronts, End to End
works.summary: Complete e-commerce experiences — storefront, cart & coupon logic, zone-based delivery pricing, order tracking, PDF invoicing, and full staff admin panels — plus a staging deployment on Node.js and PostgreSQL.
works.value: Operations-complete online businesses without enterprise licensing costs.

works.title: Email & Identity Hardening (Microsoft 365)
works.summary: Audited every mailbox for suspicious forwarding rules via PowerShell, blocked external auto-forwarding at policy level, disabled legacy authentication, and wired up alerting for new rule creation.
works.value: A silent, high-impact breach vector eliminated — before an incident, not after one.
